list.text: I got booted out of the Game Corner.\nI kept winning at the new Coin game, and they thought I was cheating...
I guess I have to do things fair and square...
My Pokémon just got a haircut!\nI'll show you how strong it is!
Your Pokémon will like you more if you give them haircuts.
Hello, dear.
I sell inexpensive herbal medicine.\nThey're good, but a trifle bitter.
Your Pokémon may not like them.\nHehehehe...
Do you consider the Pokémon types in battle?
If you know about the different types of Pokémon, you'll do better in battle.
I know all the different types of Pokémon.\nBut I only use one type.
\G\bWelcome to the Pokémon Salon!
\G\bI'm the younger and less expensive of the two Haircut Brothers.
\G\bI'll spruce up your Pokémon for just $300.
\G\bGrooming gives a better look.\nYour Pokémon will become friendlier and more beautiful.
\G\bSo? How about it?

then.text: \bOk, which Pokémon should I spruce up?

list.text: \bI have a feeling that it won't go well next time. Let me close for the day!
I think you have some rare Pokémon with you. Let me see them!
Are you making a Pokédex?\nHere's a hot tip.
You want to battle as many Trainers as you can when you see them on routes and in caves.
Their Pokémon will be recorded in the Pokédex, and they'll also make your Pokémon grow!

\f[whitney]\c[5]What?! You got the keys?! You are impressive!
\f[whitney]\c[5]Please open it! We need to expel them from Goldenrod!

We had to recruit new members for the Radio Tower mission.\nThen we ran out of uniforms.
I heard they had some here, so I decided to "borrow" one.
Since you are here, why don't you change as well?
Look at you!\nPretty good!
Oh, but you shouldn't try to scare people walking around looking like that, OK?
